description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%], [Awoken Chosen One], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast 1] and [Linked Materia Mode II (Fire, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Chosen One
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Dark and Fire abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Mesocyclone after using a Dark or Fire ability

description.name: Mesocyclone
description.text: Six single attacks (0.71 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Linked Materia Mode II (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Fire/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
